Name: Kenneth's Spacious Farm - Tall
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Want more space down, not sideways? This is it.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]80x130 = 10,400 tiles. Same width as vanilla, but double height going down. Perfect if you want to keep your farm looking normal left-right but have huge crop fields at the bottom.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Vanilla is 80x65, this is 10,400 tiles. All tillable.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Includes Standard (old saves) and Additional Farms (new game + furniture restore mail).[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]SMAPI + Content Patcher, 1.6.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Note: Inventory full at start? Place the Chest first, then store extra furniture inside. The Chest is there to help you.[/b][/size]

Downloads.Description: Old save? Use this one. Replaces vanilla Standard farm.
